
A string begins with a ''fu'ivla'' if it does not begin with a [[Morphology: cmavo|cmavo]] or a ''rafsi-string'' or a ''slinku'i'', it does begin with a non-[[Morphology: consonants|consonant]] [[Morphology: syllables|onset]], and consists of any number of [[Morphology: syllables|onstressed-syllable]]s (possibly none), one [[Morphology: syllables|stressed-syllable]] and then a [[Morphology: syllables|final-syllable]].

A ''rafsi-string'' consists of any number of [[Morphology: rafsi|y-less-rafsi]] (possibly none) followed by a [[Morphology: gismu|gismu]], a [[Morphology: rafsi|CVV-final-rafsi]], or a [[Morphology: rafsi|stressed-y-less-rafsi]] and a [[Morphology: rafsi|short-final-rafsi]]

A ''slinku'i'' consists of a [[Morphology: consonants|consonant]] followed by a ''rafsi-string''.
